summary: The diff implements the vast majority of requirements: Navigation header 'सदस्य बनें' button (REQ-1), Membership registration form page (REQ-2), Login page (REQ-3), Member Dashboard with ID card request (REQ-4), extended Admin page with tabs for members/ID card requests/login activities (REQ-5), route configuration in App.tsx (REQ-6), and extended Motoko backend (REQ-7). However, a few specific acceptance criteria have gaps: the contact form is broken after migration, the country dropdown may not list all world countries, and the Admin login activity tab rendering is unconfirmed due to truncation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Existing contact form and admin functionality is not broken — the contact form submission is now intentionally disabled, always returning an error state
missing_requirements.reason: useContactForm.ts explicitly sets isError=true and comments that submitContactForm is no longer available after migration. The constraint requires preserving all existing routes, components, and functionality including the contact form.

missing_requirements.requirement: Dropdown for देश lists ALL countries — the locationData utility appears to only contain a curated subset of countries rather than all world countries
missing_requirements.reason: frontend/src/utils/locationData.ts visible content shows only a limited set of countries. REQ-2 AC requires the देश dropdown to list all countries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes admin-only queries to list all members and all ID card requests with proper admin-only access restriction
missing_requirements.reason: The backend main.mo is truncated and it is not fully confirmable that getAllMembers and getAllIdCardRequests enforce admin-only access. The checkIsAdmin function is defined but its use in these query functions cannot be verified from the truncated diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Member login/logout/dashboard links added to Navigation header beyond the requested 'सदस्य बनें' button
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-1 only requested a 'सदस्य बनें' button in the nav. The diff also adds 'मेरा खाता' dashboard link and 'लॉगआउट' button in the navigation which were not specified.

hallucinated_features.description: backend/migration.mo migration module for transforming legacy actor state
hallucinated_features.reason: No migration requirement was specified in the build request. This is an additional infrastructure file added beyond what was requested.
